title: Spicy Thai Ramen Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired stir fry made with ramen noodles, vibrant green vegetables, and Japanese-style seasonings.

ingredients.name: Vibrant green
ingredients.notes: such as green beans or bell peppers

instructions: Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the vibrant green vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked ramen noodles, Japanese shio ramen seasoning, and fenugreek leaves to the skillet.
Stir-fry everything together for 2-3 minutes, until well combined.
